downloads.importHelp: Validated data only. Extensions apply to this session; no commands, credentials or automatic downloads.
downloads.title: Optional downloads
downloads.help: Optional resources are separate from baseline installation. Choose resources and a new folder, then review and authorize the exact native plan.
downloads.browser: Browser preview cannot list or download resources or manage credentials. Use the DEAS desktop app.
downloads.safety: No automatic download, execution or service start. Anonymous access may encounter rate limits, gated licenses or paid-resource restrictions. Placement in managed folders is separate.
downloads.tokenHelp: Anonymous by default. Tokens stay in native session memory unless you explicitly choose the OS credential store. No plaintext fallback. Token presence does not verify an account, license or entitlement.
downloads.authError: Authorization failed. Check the provider and credential store; no credential details are displayed.
downloads.more: This is a bounded listing, not a claim of completeness. Continue explicitly when another page is available.
downloads.empty: No resources listed for this provider. Browse explicitly or refresh the catalog.
downloads.blocked: Native plan is blocked; review warnings before preparing a different plan.
downloads.consent: I authorize only this exact optional download plan.
downloads.emptyCategory: No catalog entries in this category.
